head.title: By Water Taxi
head.lede: From the Hotel Gabrielli landing on Riva degli Schiavoni straight to the pavilion’s own landing inside the Arsenale Militare. The ride threads north through the canals of Castello, out into the North Lagoon and back in through Rio delle Galeazze — roughly 15 to 20 minutes on the water.
intro: Ask the hotel to book the taxi, then show this page to the driver. Access to the Arsenale is coordinated by Julda: the driver must call before entering.
contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.intro: All water access to the pavilion is coordinated by Julda. If you run into any trouble, call in this order:
route.title: The Route
route.body: West along the Bacino, then north through Rio della Pietà, Rio di Sant’Antonin and Rio di Santa Giustina. Out in the North Lagoon the taxi turns east past the Celestia stop, then south into the Arsenale through Rio delle Galeazze — the only permitted entrance — to the landing beside Tesa 41.
route.caption: Blue dot: Hotel Gabrielli landing · Red dot: pavilion landing · Animated line: the water taxi route
driver.title: Driver Instructions
driver.intro: Show this section to your driver.
card.subtitle: Hotel Gabrielli → Armenian Pavilion · Arsenale Militare
card.authorized-1: This water taxi is authorized to enter the military Arsenale because it is carrying guests visiting the Armenian Pavilion.
card.authorized-2: The Marine Office has approved access for water taxis bringing visitors to the Armenian Pavilion. Access is coordinated by Julda: do not contact the Marine Office directly.
card.before-quote: “I am arriving with a visitor for the Armenian Pavilion.”
card.before-note: If Julda does not answer, call Luca.
card.entrance-name: Galeazze – North Lagoon side – Rio delle Galeazze
card.entrance-body: Approach from the north side of the lagoon and enter through Rio delle Galeazze.
card.entrance-warn: Do not use any other entrance to the Arsenale.
card.step-1: Depart from the Hotel Gabrielli landing on Riva degli Schiavoni and head west along the Bacino.
card.step-2: Enter Rio della Pietà, beside the Chiesa della Pietà, and follow it north into Rio di Sant’Antonin.
card.step-3: Continue north along Rio di Santa Giustina and exit into the North Lagoon.
card.step-4: Turn east and follow the shore past the Celestia stop to the Arsenale.
card.step-5: Enter through the only permitted entrance: Galeazze – Rio delle Galeazze.
card.step-6: Continue south along Rio delle Galeazze to the Armenian Pavilion landing, beside Tesa 41.
